# SUS WEARS — llms.txt

> SUS WEARS (Shedrack Unisex Stitches) is a contemporary unisex fashion house based in Lagos, Nigeria. Founded in 2019 by Mr. Shedrack, the brand creates clothing for men and women from a single design language — cut to fit the body, not the catalogue.

## About

SUS WEARS draws from African textile traditions and Western garment construction. The silhouette is the logo: no prints, no badges, identity lives in proportion — the fall of a trench, the fold of a hood, the weight of fabric that hangs instead of hovering.

- **Legal name:** Shedrack Unisex Stitches
- **Founder:** Mr. Shedrack
- **Founded:** 2019
- **Based in:** Lagos, Nigeria
- **Contact:** suswears469@gmail.com | WhatsApp: +234 907 097 0886
- **Website:** https://sus-wears.vercel.app

## Collections

- **Signature** — The core wardrobe. Unisex silhouettes cut to last beyond a single season. (/collections/signature)
- **After Dark** — A darker wardrobe for night. Matte surfaces, deep tones. (/collections/after-dark)
- **Limited** — Small-run pieces. When they sell out, they are gone. (/collections/limited)
